summary: Full destruction of a doubly-linked-list sentinel struct (4 DWORDs at this+0/4/8/C). Two phases: (1) if the list is non-empty, walk each node from the head and reparent its value elsewhere via LinkedListNodePrepend, advancing a cursor stored at this+8 along each node's next pointer (+4); (2) walk the remaining nodes and free them, calling EmptyStub_0170 on a node's value when the node's flags byte at +8 is non-zero and the value is non-null, then FreeWrapper_7bcf on the value and on the node. Finally zeroes all four DWORD fields of the sentinel and returns 1.

local_names.a1: list sentinel (head at +0, tail at +4, cursor at +8, count at +C)
local_names.v5: next node pointer during reparent walk
local_names.v8: node flags byte at node + 8 (non-zero marks the value as active)

operations.description: Copy the list head pointer into the cursor field: *(this + 8) = *(this + 0).
When the head pointer (this + 0) is null the list is empty and the reparent walk is skipped.

Reparent walk: for each node starting at the head, call LinkedListNodePrepend(node) to move the node's value to another list, then advance the cursor (this + 8) to the next node via node+4; the loop ends when the next node or its pointer is null.
Free walk: iterate the node chain from the head; for each node read its flags byte at node+8 and its value pointer at node+0.
When the node's flags byte is non-zero and its value pointer is non-null, call EmptyStub_0170(value) before freeing the value.
Free the node memory with FreeWrapper_7bcf(node), and FreeWrapper_7bcf(value) first when the flags byte marked the value active.
Zero all four DWORD fields of the sentinel: this+0, this+4, this+8 and this+C.

unresolved: The destination of the reparent step is opaque: LinkedListNodePrepend moves the node's value to another list, but which list (and whether the reparent is a detach of shared values or an actual move) is not established by the packet.

The legacy ABI name 'List_Iterator_Full_Destruction' (abi:lead) describes an iterator destruction, whereas the raw source frees every node and the node values; the fill's name 'ListDetachAndFreeAll' is used here.
The node layout (value at +0, next at +4, flags at +8) and the meaning of the non-zero flags byte are inferred from the raw source; no class or node type is evidenced.
